items.title: This Free Tool Replaces TeamViewer AND AnyDesk
items.description: Try Opera browser FOR FREE here: https://opr.as/Opera-browser-techhut RustDesk is arguably the best open source alternative to TeamViewer and AnyDesk, and in this guide we take it a step further by self-hosting our own relay and signal server.
